blocks.text:
This journey through Costa Rica takes you into dense rainforest and to deserted beaches, waterfalls, lagoons and natural pools shaped by the Pacific tides. San José is your arrival and departure point, while the main nature experiences centre on Corcovado and a boat excursion to Caño Island.

The tour gives you the chance to see two different ecosystems in a short time. In Corcovado, you walk through the forest, shifting your attention between plants, birds and large animals. At Caño Island, the focus moves underwater, where coral reefs, volcanic rocks and numerous fish become the main features of the day.
